life_facts.text: If your income stopped tomorrow, your cash would cover 65.4 months of your bills
In a middle future, 'Spend less where you spend far more than people like you (€603 a month)' leaves you about €154k more at 46, which is 3.7 years of your current spending
In a middle future, 'Do all of the above' leaves you about €337k more at 46, which is 8.1 years of your current spending
In a bad future, 'Do all of the above' protects about €220k, or 5.3 years of your current spending
Selling in a crash instead of holding by rule can cost you about €111k at 46

actions.ranking_rule: grouped into this week / this month / with your advisor; inside a group: 2 x goal points + risk points + event points / 10 + 3 x urgency + 1 if you can do it alone

output.intro: Your goal: Build €500k of wealth by age 46, 62% chance today. The quick wins free €603 a month. Quick wins first, then one advisor conversation.

actions.title: Set a €280 monthly limit for eating out
actions.why: Eating out: €585 a month, people like you spend about €226. Effect on your goal: +11 points. That is €55k freed over 15 years.
actions.how: Set a €280 limit in the app. You get a nudge at 80% of it, and whatever you do not spend under the limit moves into your savings.
actions.verified_by: Bank data: two months at or below the limit

actions.title: Set a €340 monthly limit for shopping
actions.why: Shopping: €500 a month, people like you spend about €272. Effect on your goal: +6 points. That is €29k freed over 15 years.
actions.how: Set a €340 limit in the app. You get a nudge at 80% of it, and whatever you do not spend under the limit moves into your savings.
actions.verified_by: Bank data: two months at or below the limit

actions.title: Cancel what you no longer use (€138 a month)
actions.why: You pay €138 a month for Wine club and Fitness studio, which you no longer use. Effect on your goal: +5 points. That is €25k freed over 15 years.
actions.how: Cancel Wine club and Fitness studio in the app's subscription view. The freed €138 a month moves into your savings automatically.

actions.title: Write your will with the guided checklist
actions.why: €276k of savings and investments would pass on without a will. It protects you rather than clearly raising the goal chance.
actions.how: Answer the 12-question checklist in the app, then book a notary and upload the signed will.

actions.title: Write down your rules for falling markets
actions.why: You sold everything in the crash test. Effect on your goal: +14 points.
actions.how: Write down your rules for a falling market with your advisor, then practise them in the crash review.
actions.verified_by: Advisor confirmed, then passed again in the crash review
